summary: Frontend-only verification of webdash Broadcast enhancements (Quick Templates + Delivery Receipts) at /api/dash. All critical flows PASS: login as Demo CGM (+919000000500/123456), Send Notification screen loads with broadcast-title, Compose tab shows bc-templates card with exactly 6 built-in template chips (shift_change, safety_alert, maintenance, holiday, salary, assembly) using colon-containing testIDs. Tapping bc-tpl-builtin:safety_alert correctly fills bc-title-input ('सुरक्षा इशारा'), bc-body-input, highlights bc-prio-emergency, and the bc-preview phone mock reflects filled text. Save-as-template works end-to-end: button enabled after title+message, click bc-save-template -> bc-success 'Template saved ✓' appears, new custom chip bc-tpl-<uuid> added with delete control bc-tpl-del-<uuid>; clicking the X with confirm() accept removes the chip. Delivery receipts flow fully works: audience Everyone (bc-aud-all), fill unique content, bc-review-send opens bc-confirm-modal, bc-confirm-send POSTs and lands in History; row bc-hist-<uuid> opens bc-detail-modal; bc-view-receipts reveals bc-receipts-panel with all 7 filter chips showing counts (All 35, Delivered 0, Opened 0, Sent 0, Failed 0, No app/push off 35, Quiet hours 0) and bc-receipts-list with 35 recipient rows (name + status chip). Filtering by bc-rfilter-no_token keeps 35 rows (all no_token in this demo bubble); bc-rfilter-delivered shows empty state (0 delivered). Role gate verified: Demo Worker +919000000001 is denied with 'Access restricted' screen and nav-broadcast is NOT rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: Broadcast.tsx (632 lines) is just under the 700-line soft cap; consider splitting Compose/History/DetailModal into separate files to keep it maintainable as more features (templates, receipts) grow.
deleteTemplate() uses window.confirm which is browser-blocking; works today but a styled modal would be more consistent with the rest of the webdash (bc-confirm-modal style).

The 'Switched OFF for real users' red topbar overlay persists across every webdash screen — purely cosmetic (iteration 27/28 pre-existing); verified it does not intercept any clicks in the Broadcast flow.
seed_data_creation: Created one real broadcast via Demo CGM (audience=all, 35 recipients) during live send test; it now appears in bc-hist as the top row and is used to drive the receipts verification. No cleanup needed (demo bubble auto-purges per standing scheduler).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Webdash Broadcast at /api/dash. Login Demo CGM +919000000500 / OTP 123456 (phone input requires +91 prefix, length>=13). Built-in template chip IDs literally contain a colon, so always escape via [data-testid="bc-tpl-builtin:safety_alert"] (quote the attribute). History row IDs are bc-hist-<uuid>; the search input ALSO has data-testid='bc-hist-search' and the type select is 'bc-hist-type' — filter rows with regex /^bc-hist-[0-9a-f]{8}-/ to avoid picking those up. Delete template uses window.confirm → register page.once('dialog', d.accept()) BEFORE clicking the ✕. In the demo bubble all 35 recipients are 'no_token' (none have mobile app tokens), so Delivered/Opened/Sent/Failed counts are 0 — expected, not a bug.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bugs found. Both new features (Quick Templates CRUD and Delivery Receipts UI) work end-to-end with correct data, counts, filtering and role gating.
